doc_title: Tarrenfield Oakes Real Estate Partners III Confidential Private Placement Memorandum
notes: Closed-end value-add real estate PPM in which the service-provider section (Section 9.2) and the closing directory (Appendix A) still name Wexcombe Adair LLP as auditor, while a Recent Developments section added later (Section 13.4) replaces it with Lindenhall Crewe LLP, so the stale name is also the last one in the file. Redemption frequency, notice, lock-up and gate are expressly inapplicable, no high-water mark applies, and no prime broker is mentioned, with a broker-dealer placement agent and a subscription lender nearby as plausible wrong answers. The management fee changes basis at the end of the Investment Period and has a lower rate for $50 million commitments, and the 9% IRR preferred return is a hard hurdle in the Section 5.3 sense (paid in cash in full before any distribution to the General Partner) that still carries a 50/50 catch-up, a pairing market usage often calls soft.

traps.auditor: Section 9.2 and the Appendix A directory (the last mention in the file) name Wexcombe Adair LLP, but Section 13.4 replaced it with Lindenhall Crewe LLP effective June 1, 2026, so the current auditor is Lindenhall Crewe LLP.
traps.prime_broker: No prime broker is named or referred to anywhere; the broker-dealer placement agent (Norcastle Lyle Securities) and the subscription facility lender (Ellery Plains Bank) are not prime brokers, so the answer is NOT_FOUND.
traps.lockup_period: Section 6.3 states expressly that no lock-up applies because Interests cannot be withdrawn or redeemed; the fund term, the closing period and loan tenors are not lock-ups.
traps.redemption_frequency: Section 6.3 states Limited Partners have no right to withdraw or redeem, and neither the quarterly distribution policy nor the General Partner's compulsory withdrawal power is an investor redemption right.
traps.redemption_notice_days: No redemption notice period applies (Section 6.3); the 10 Business Day capital call notice, 30-day transfer notice, 30-day MFN election window and 180-day key person window are not redemption notice.
traps.gate_provision: Section 6.3 states expressly that no gate applies to the Interests, which carry no redemption right; the investment concentration limits and the 25% Subscription Facility cap are not gates.
traps.high_water_mark: Section 5.4 (General Partner Clawback) states expressly that no high-water mark or loss carryforward applies, relying instead on a cumulative whole-of-fund waterfall and the General Partner Clawback, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
traps.management_fee: The fee basis moves from Capital Commitments during the Investment Period to Invested Equity afterwards, and Large Commitment Limited Partners ($50 million or more) pay 1.25% instead of 1.50%; the affiliated property management percentages in Section 4.3 are not the Management Fee.
